Container.Name: ReelIndex
Container.Overview:
ReelIndex is a read-only movie inventory application for local folders, Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. It provides poster and table views, Quick and resumable Deep scans, bounded native container analysis, ffprobe fallback, manual poster management, Probe Failures diagnosis, structured scan logs, and scheduled rescans.
The Docker and Windows editions use the same v1.4.5 backend and browser interface.
Container.Requires: Media mappings must be read-only. Configure filesystem sources using the container path, such as /media. For another library, add another read-only Path mapping with a distinct container path such as /media2.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the ReelIndex web interface.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, encrypted source credentials, poster cache, scan events, and resumable Deep Scan queues.

Config.Name: Movie Library
Config.Description: Primary movie library. Configure the ReelIndex filesystem source as /media.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for scheduled scans and container timestamps.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used for writable application data. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used for application data and media reads. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for ReelIndex data.

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set to true only to seed a synthetic demonstration library.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Python logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

Config.Name: Verbose Scan Logging
Config.Description: Record per-file and per-stage scan timings. Enable only while benchmarking or troubleshooting.

Config.Name: TMDB API Token
Config.Description: Optional TMDB bearer token for poster matching and manual poster search.

Config.Name: ffprobe Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum number of seconds allowed for compatibility ffprobe operations.

Config.Name: MediaInfo Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum number of seconds allowed for MediaInfo operations.

Config.Name: Allowed Extensions
Config.Description: Comma-separated video extensions included in filesystem scans.

Container.Changes:
### 2026.08.02 — v1.4.5 - Synchronized Docker/Unraid with the complete Windows feature set. - Added native bounded parsers, resumable Deep Scan, poster management, Probe Failures, targeted retries, and structured scan output. - Added MediaInfo CLI and current ffprobe support to the image. - Replaced the legacy React build with the same static interface used by Windows. - Added GHCR publishing, amd64/arm64 builds, health validation, and upgrade-safe PUID/PGID handling.
### 2026.07.31 — v1.0.3 - Added ReelIndex icon, favicons, and packaging refinements.
